initialization: W1 original nn.Linear defaults; W2 exact official uniform shared matrix, independent random signs r, s=ones, identical initial hidden biases, independent uniform heads; no A0 warmstart
preprocessing: original patientwise unlabeled z; mean imputer/StandardScaler FIT only; same tensors as frozen A0
orientation: NEZ=1/EZ=0; mean sigmoid(member NEZ logits); EZ=1-p_NEZ
W2_loss: unreduced pos-weighted BCE per channel/member; mean members then mean channels; one update per patient
bootstrap_unit: 47 patient IDs; keep all65 appearances; fixed checkpoints/numeric thresholds
terminal_supported: gate PASS and lower95% primary delta CIs>0 for both A0 and W1; target additionally point gain>=.030
terminal_capacity_only: W1 improves A0 and W2 point improves A0 but not W1; qualifier on CI required
terminal_inconclusive: positive W2-A0 point gain but unsupported by gate/primary paired CIs
terminal_other: TABM_NOT_SUPPORTED if W2-A0<=0 unless blocked engineering
member_diagnostics: each member evaluated at its parent ensemble selected fold threshold; extra standalone member-optimal threshold diagnostic allowed only labeled posthoc, not deployed
disagreement: mean pairwise binary disagreement using ensemble selected NEZ threshold, patient equal; also probability variance and pairwise correlations
patient_improvement_distribution: aggregate quantiles, fractions improved/tied/worse only; no individual IDs public
efficiency: same device; synchronized epoch optimization+validation time summed, save I/O excluded; peak allocated GPU bytes incl inputs/model/optimizer; selected model inference10 warmups/20 repeats on whole validation fold; A0 training runtime not estimable/no retrain
outer_test: no outer prediction or metric evaluation, even if gate passes
public_outputs: source and compact non-identifiable aggregates only
